$comment: Narrow production-source exemptions for scan-token-usage.mjs. Every exemption needs a domain or integration reason; tests and generated files are excluded by the scanner.

exemptions.reason: Selectors target Recharts default SVG attributes; Qeetrix replaces their rendered values with semantic chart tokens.
ColorPicker accepts, validates, previews, and emits literal hex values as domain data for native input type=color.
The qrcode library requires literal RGBA hex values; these are encoding inputs rather than Qeetrix styling.
